name: Earl of Lemongrab
title: Unstable ruler of the lemon people
description:
The Earl of Lemongrab is one of the most intense and uncomfortable characters in Adventure Time. Created by Princess Bubblegum, he is a lemon person whose personality is built around instability, control, and extreme emotional reactions. He speaks in a loud, harsh, and dramatic voice, and his behavior is often both funny and disturbing.

Lemongrab is obsessed with rules, authority, and what he considers acceptable. He reacts badly to disorder, difference, or anything that feels wrong to him. This makes his kingdom a deeply strange and unpleasant place, and it also makes him one of the clearest examples in the series of how flawed creation and leadership can go badly.

At the same time, Lemongrab is more than just a joke character. He represents isolation, emotional imbalance, and the pain of being unable to connect normally with others. His episodes are often absurd, but they also carry a disturbing edge that makes him unforgettable. He is one of the strangest characters in Ooo, and that is exactly why he stands out.
